parameters.name: attrclass
parameters.label: Attribute Class
parameters.description: Operate on point, vertex, or primitive attributes.

parameters.name: group
parameters.label: Group
parameters.description: Point or primitive group to operate on.

parameters.name: inputattrscope
parameters.label: Input Attribute Scope
parameters.description: Input attribute name or components (e.g., P(1) P(0) for reorder).

parameters.name: parsize
parameters.label: Parameter Size
parameters.description: Number of independent parameter values (per-component control).

parameters.name: preadd
parameters.label: Pre Add
parameters.description: Value to add before the multiply.

parameters.name: postadd
parameters.label: Post Add
parameters.description: Value to add after the multiply.

parameters.name: overrideautoattr
parameters.label: Override Auto Attribute
parameters.description: Manually specify output attribute type and components.

parameters.name: attrnumcomps
parameters.label: Components
parameters.description: Number of components in output attribute.

description: Single-attribute math operator with Pre Operation → Pre Add → Multiply → Post Add → Post Operation pipeline. Supports Parameter Size 1-4 for per-component control. Includes built-in ReRange and Quantize. Generates GLSL-compatible operations.
